announce.editedRegister: {{name}} edited at the classical register, column {{column}}.

comments.heading: Comments
comments.hint: Select a gate to comment on it, or write about the circuit as a whole. A resolved thread stays here, so "we discussed this and decided" is not lost.

anchor.orphaned: The gate this was about is no longer in this document

comments.orphanNotice_one: {{count}} thread below is about a gate that is no longer in this document. It is kept, because what was said still happened.
comments.orphanNotice_other: {{count}} threads below are about gates that are no longer in this document. They are kept, because what was said still happened.

empty.open: No open threads on this circuit.
empty.resolved: No resolved threads on this circuit.
empty.all: Nobody has commented on this circuit yet.

comments.full: This circuit has reached its limit of {{max}} threads. Resolve or delete one to start another.

compose.label: New comment
compose.hint: Up to {{max}} characters. Text between backticks is shown as notation.

thread.reveal: Show this gate on the canvas

announce.revealMissing: The gate this comment was about is not in this circuit.

ended.unauthorised: This circuit stopped being yours to open, so the shared session ended.
ended.overloaded: The shared session could not keep up with the changes and ended. Reopen the circuit to rejoin.
ended.gone: The shared session was let go. Reopen the circuit to rejoin.

session.readOnly: You are watching this session. Only the owner may edit.
session.invalid: The shared document reached a state this circuit cannot hold, so the session was let go.
session.unavailable: The shared session could not be opened, so this circuit is yours alone in this tab.
session.diverged: Some of your changes were too large to send, so the shared session does not have them yet.
session.tooLarge: This document has grown past what a shared session can serve, so this circuit is yours alone in this tab.
session.disabled: Shared sessions are switched off here, so this circuit is yours alone in this tab.

deferred.heading_one: {{formatted}} operation is in the document but not on the canvas
deferred.heading_other: {{formatted}} operations are in the document but not on the canvas
deferred.hint: Two people wrote to the same place. Nothing was lost and everybody’s copy agrees — these are held back until something makes room for them.
deferred.unreadable: An operation this version cannot read

reason.column-conflict: Another gate already holds that cell.
reason.clbit-in-use: Another gate in that column already writes that classical bit.
reason.out-of-register: It names a wire or a classical bit this circuit does not have.
reason.malformed: The document holds a shape that is not an operation.
reason.invalid: The circuit does not accept it as it stands.

deferred.unresolvable: No edit here can place it.
deferred.overflow_one: {{formatted}} further operation in this document is past what one circuit can hold, and is not read at all.
deferred.overflow_other: {{formatted}} further operations in this document are past what one circuit can hold, and are not read at all.

announce.revealed_one: Selected the gate that is in the way.
announce.revealed_other: Selected the {{count}} gates that are in the way.
announce.gone: What was holding it is no longer in this circuit.
announce.madeRoom: Made room. The held operation should appear on the canvas.
announce.widened: Widened the register. The held operation should appear on the canvas.
announce.refused: That could not be done. The document may have changed.

deferred.label: Operations held back
